{{Quote|Since departing Serroco, our ranks have been reduced to [force disposition classified]. I am hopeful that we will be able to make Myrkr or the Ryyk Nebula, where we might reform with the Tremendous group arriving from [point of origin classified].|Dispatch from Saul Karath|<ref name="Admiral's List">{{KOTORbackups|16}}</ref>}}
The '''Ryyk Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] that formed from the [[Ryyk supernova|remnants]] of a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Trans-Vulta sector/Legends|Trans-Vulta sector]]. During the [[Mandalorian Wars]]&mdash;a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior clans&mdash;Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]] made plans to regroup in the nebula after being forced to retreat from a nearby [[Battle of Serroco|battle]]. The Republic's successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], operated a major [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] in the nebula.

==Description==
The Ryyk Nebula was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Trans-Vulta sector/Legends|Trans-Vulta sector]].<ref name="Atlas" /> It was formed from the [[Ryyk supernova|remnants]] of a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]<ref name="Formed" /> that destroyed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryyk]].<ref name="Power of the Jedi">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Captainkarath.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Saul Karath commanded a battle group near the Ryyk Nebula.]]
Shortly before the start of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]],<ref name="Supernova Date">{{CSWECite|III|119|Ryyk (I)}} states that [[Ryyk]] was [[Ryyk supernova|destroyed]] shortly before the start of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to [[3996 BBY]].</ref> a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]'s [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]]<ref name="Atlas" /> that began in [[3996 BBY]],<ref name="Supernova Date" /> a supernova destroyed the planet Ryyk.<ref name="Formed" /> By around [[3963 BBY]],<ref name="Kotor16">[[Knights of the Old Republic 16|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 16]]</ref> the remnants of the supernova had formed the Ryyk Nebula.<ref name="Power of the Jedi" /> Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], a Republic [[Battle Group Serroco|battle group]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]] fought in a [[Battle of Serroco|battle]] at the planet [[Serroco]]<ref name="Kotor15">[[Knights of the Old Republic 15|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 15]]</ref> near the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] as part of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]&mdash;a conflict fought between the Republic and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior clans. After being forced to retreat from the battle, Karath planned to regroup with the Republic's [[Tremendous group|''Tremendous'' group]] at either the Ryyk Nebula<ref name="Admiral's List" /> or the planet<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Myrkr]].<ref name="Admiral's List" />

A report indicating the admiral's possible rendezvous was published in [[The Admiral's List]], an official publication of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] that covered news related to the war effort.<ref name="Admiral's List" /> However, Karath and the remains of his battle group were attacked and never reached the nebula or Myrkr.<ref name="Kotor17">[[Knights of the Old Republic 17|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 17]]</ref> By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the nebula was the site of a major [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] that produced [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Galactic Republic's successor.<ref name="Guide to Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The Kyyr system is a hasty reversal of Ryyk, which I discovered late in the publication process had to be near Mandalore.|Jason Fry, on placing Ryyk in ''The Essential Atlas''|<ref name="Essential Atlas Endnotes">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2009/08/endnotes-for-star-wars-essential-atlas_24.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 2 of 5)}}</ref>}}
The Ryyk Nebula was first mentioned in "[[The Admiral's List: Remember Serroco! Edition]]," an [[in-universe]] news report that appeared on the final page of the [[Knights of the Old Republic 16|sixteenth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]]. The issue was written by [[John Jackson Miller]]<ref name="Kotor16" /> and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[May 2]], [[2007]].<ref name="Kotor16 Release">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/14-397/Star-Wars-Knights-of-the-Old-Republic-16|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #16}}</ref> ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book released on [[August 18]], [[2009]] and written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]],<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> placed the nebula in grid square N-7.<ref name="Atlas" /> In a blog post released on [[August 24]] of the same year, Fry revealed that the [[Kyyr system]] mentioned in ''The Essential Atlas'' was originally "Ryyk" before it was discovered late in the publication process that the latter had to be near to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="Essential Atlas Endnotes" /> a planet located in grid square O-7.<ref name="Atlas" />
